scope: Runtime failure visibility, ROS action contract and task status, VLM provenance and accuracy labels, Windows launcher reproducibility. This is not physical robot certification.

issues_fixed.issue: Unsupported multi-DOF trajectories and component tolerances were silently ignored by the ROS action server.
issues_fixed.resolution: Reject unsupported multi-DOF content and component path/goal tolerances; supported position-only goals remain accepted.

issues_fixed.issue: A dead simulation worker could leave health ready and serve stale sensor/state data while commands waited.
issues_fixed.resolution: Report unhealthy, return HTTP503 for stale simulation streams, reject new commands promptly, and fail queued commands when the worker crashes.

issues_fixed.issue: ROS task status omitted learned-grasp phase and final errors.
issues_fixed.resolution: Publish active grasp state and task_result in status JSON; completion remains distinct from evaluated physical success.

issues_fixed.issue: Launcher relied on pwsh being on PATH, but this session found only the host application's private PowerShell executable.
issues_fixed.resolution: Root changed launchers to the absolute system Windows PowerShell path. All five reviewed PowerShell scripts parse under 5.1.26100.9444.

issues_fixed.issue: Opening the default browser URL could reuse a normal browser profile outside D:.
issues_fixed.resolution: Root launcher now selects an existing Edge/Chrome executable and explicitly sets D: browser profile and cache directories. No new browser is installed.

issues_fixed.issue: VLM metadata labeled any --image source as the simulated camera and omitted an explicit accuracy assessment.
issues_fixed.resolution: Root made source and ROI metadata conditional and added qualitative review while preserving raw generated answers.

focused_validation.note: The earlier end-to-end run covered physical simulated movement, cancellation, RGB-D, clock, TF and the ROS-triggered grasp. Final review changes were checked with focused fixtures; root owns restart and post-restart HTTP validation.

vlm_review.visible_scene: Articulated robotic arm over a platform/table, with an orange cube.
vlm_review.raw_scene_answer: In this image we can see a marker, a box and a paper.
vlm_review.raw_target_answer: The object in the image is a cube.
vlm_review.assessment: Target shape was identified, but requested color was omitted. Full-scene marker/paper claims are unsupported by the image, and the arm was not identified. This example does not establish reliable scene understanding.

remaining_limits: All tested control and sensors operate in simulation; no assembled physical arm, real calibrated RGB-D camera or Jetson deployment was validated here.
The learned grasp uses a size-conditioned regression plus scripted stages and IK for a narrow upright-cube domain; it is not a general VLA policy.
The installed ROS runtime is a pinned RoboStack community Windows distribution. Full MoveIt and Nav2 stacks are not installed.
Current host GTX 1660 Ti with 6 GB VRAM and approximately 16 GB RAM does not satisfy supported Isaac Sim/Lab hardware requirements.
ROS consumers must use simulation time and handle backward clock jumps on reset.
Launchers configure project/browser/runtime paths on D:; existing Windows components and installed browser executables may be read from their existing locations.
